issuer: the Ministry of the Interior (Ministarstvo unutrašnjih poslova)
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Road Traffic Safety Act (Zakon o bezbjednosti saobraćaja na putevima, Službeni list CG 33/2012, 58/2014, 14/2017 (Constitutional Court) and 66/2019), as the Government's site gov.me publishes it (the file of 1 July 2021, found through its document search): a licence for category B may be issued from 18 (art. 179(1)4); a category B licence is issued for ten years (art. 189); the Ministry issues it (art. 190), the Ministry being the state administration body for internal affairs (defined at its first use, art. 131). No later amendment was found in the Government's document search, but a working group on the Act was named in August 2024, so a newer text may exist. The form doesn't hold the older-driver terms: three years over 67, and to 67 for a holder over 57 at issue (art. 189), nor a shorter term on medical advice. Fee null: the Law on Administrative Taxes (Službeni list CG 18/19, the Government's file of 15 October 2025) charges a tax of EUR 10 'for the driving licence' (tariff no. 17(1)), but the price of the licence form itself, which the applicant also pays, wasn't read, so the tax isn't held as the licence's fee. No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read (tariff no. 17(3) taxes an exchange of a foreign licence at EUR 30).

sources.title: Zakon o bezbjednosti saobraćaja na putevima (Government of Montenegro, gov.me)
sources.said: Zakon je objavljen u "Službenom listu CG", br. 33/2012, 58/2014 i 14/2017 - Odluka US CG i 66/2019. ... Vozačka dozvola može se izdati licu koje je navršilo: ... 18 godina života za kategorije B, B1 i B+E; ... Vozačka dozvola za upravljanje motornim vozilima odnosno skupovima vozila kategorije AM, A1, A2, A, B, B1 i B+E izdaje se sa rokom važenja od deset godina. ... Licima starijim od 67 godina života vozačka dozvola se izdaje sa rokom važenja od tri godine. ... Vozačku dozvolu izdaje Ministarstvo. ... organ državne uprave nadležan za unutrašnje poslove (u daljem tekstu: Ministarstvo).

sources.title: Zakon o administrativnim taksama (Government of Montenegro, gov.me)
sources.said: Tarifni broj 17 ... Za vozačku dozvolu 10,00; ... Za zamjenu inostrane vozačke dozvole dozvolom Crne Gore 30,00.
